title: Adrenal fatigue
metaDescription: Adrenal fatigue support with Touch for Health Kinesiology and Nutrition — Patricia Smith at Equilibrium in Takaka, Golden Bay, NZ.

blocks.html: When energy is flat, stress sits in the body, and “just rest more” is not enough, clients in Golden Bay often look for a way to ask the body what it needs — not another one-size protocol.

Patricia combines Touch for Health Kinesiology with Nutrition. Muscle testing can highlight nutrient imbalances, food stressors, and emotional holding patterns that keep the system on high alert. Food and simple touch techniques are used together so support is tailored to you, not copied from a generic adrenal checklist.
Clients who came for adrenal fatigue and related food allergies have reported improved energy, better-matched supplements, and relief from issues that had not shifted with other approaches alone.

items: People who feel wired-and-tired or drained despite trying harder
